description: Search the Corporate Affairs Commission's (CAC) public register for businesses already registered in Nigeria, by name or by RC/BN number. Returns `results`: name, rc_number (the BN number for a business name), registration_date, classification, nature_of_business, status (e.g. ACTIVE or INACTIVE), company_id, classification_id and match (exact, close, similar or null), best match first; RC/BN numbers ("RC 8911267") are read as numbers. Lead with the result whose match is exact; when none is, say plainly that nothing is registered under that exact name before listing the closest. This lists what exists; it isn't an availability check (check_name_availability and check_business_name_compliance are). An `error` never means there's no match.

entity_type.description: Limit to one kind of registration. Defaults to ALL.

query.description: A business name, or an RC/BN number such as '1234567'.

name: search_cac_register

match.description: How close the name is to the query; results come best first.

rc_number.description: RC number (BN number for a business name).

status.description: CAC status, e.g. ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

title: Search CAC's public register
